rubric.evidence: Verified directly against Blink html_image_element.idl/.h/.cc (replacedByUserAgent, onuareplacestart, onuareplaceend, non-bubbling/non-cancelable Event::Create enqueued on TaskType::kDOMManipulation, DOM disconnect/src-change resets), event_type_names.json5, image_replacement.cc (UA shadow root subframe isolation), runtime_enabled_features.json5 (UAImageReplacementAPI origin trial only), explainer README.md, BCD, webstatus.dev, and ChromeStatus 5076374013476864 on 2026-11-27.

Feature 5076374013476864 is listed under 'Origin trial' in /api/v0/features?milestone=152 with exact listing name 'User Agent Image Replacement API'; OT runs Chrome 152-157 desktop (browsers.chrome.desktop is null, not yet shipped); .warn-block accurately documents OT ID 1722063907515793409 and --enable-blink-features=UAImageReplacementAPI with no data-shipped-in.
Covers all 3 developer-facing surfaces (HTMLImageElement.replacedByUserAgent, uareplacestart/onuareplacestart, and uareplaceend/onuareplaceend) across all 9 dimensions.

Documents exact event properties (bubbles: false, cancelable: false), capture-phase ancestor listening requirement, DOM disconnect / adopt / src-change resets vs moveBefore() preservation, UA shadow-root isolation, and anti-fingerprinting discretion.

Embeds live HTTP-200 Chrome Platform Showcase adapting-around-it demo with sandbox and referrerpolicy, links both sibling concepts, and provides a verified JS capture-phase adaptation example reconciling already-replaced images.

Honestly reports Origin trial 152-157 desktop status (not enabled by default), notes missing BCD entry, and demonstrates feature detection via 'replacedByUserAgent' in HTMLImageElement.prototype with clean degradation.

Every visible source and citation label links directly to primary artifacts with target='_blank' rel='noopener'; all CPS demo URLs and conformance HTML/JSON verified HTTP 200 on 2026-11-27; feature-root links marked data-demo-rel='related'.

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2/h3 hierarchy, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, captioned tables with <th scope='col|row'>, focusable .table-wrap scroll regions and <pre tabindex='0'>, descriptive iframe title, and visible :focus-visible outline.

Uses shared /public/styles.css editorial tokens, logical sizing (max-inline-size, inline-size), display: block on embedded iframe, and horizontally scrollable tables without horizontal document overflow.

Verified HTTP 200 on 2026-11-27 for https://chrome-platform-showcase.kinlan-test.workers.dev/v152/user-agent-image-replacement-api/adapting-around-it/ and parent conformance suite (/v152/user-agent-image-replacement-api/conformance + conformance.json: release v152, featureSlug user-agent-image-replacement-api, chromestatusId 5076374013476864).

guidanceConsulted.query: semantic HTML landmarks accessible tables keyboard navigation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), sequential heading hierarchy, <figure>/<figcaption> for embedded examples, <pre tabindex='0'><code> for keyboard-scrollable code blocks, and loading='lazy' with descriptive iframe titles.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, <footer class='byline'>, <pre tabindex='0'><code> on all code blocks, and loading='lazy' with descriptive title on the CPS iframe.

guidanceConsulted.query: semantic HTML landmarks accessible tables keyboard navigation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Provide native table captions and <th scope='col|row'>, visible :focus-visible outlines on focusable scroll regions, and avoid redundant ARIA roles on native semantic elements.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: captioned tables with scope attributes, .table-wrap:focus-visible outline on scrollable table wrappers, and native landmarks without redundant ARIA.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible responsive documentation table code block without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing (inline-size, max-inline-size) and contained horizontal scrolling wrappers so wide tables and embeds never cause viewport horizontal overflow on mobile.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: max-inline-size: 100% on .table-wrap and embedded iframe with overflow scrolling inside .table-wrap.
